invariants: ZERO SYNTHETIC/MOCK DATA: Never hardcode mock candidate data in production views; bind to real database records.
ZERO RAW HTML LEAKAGE: All rich text inputs must be sanitized and rendered as styled HTML elements, never literal string tags.
CUBA DESIGN SYSTEM & A4 INTEGRITY: Maintain exact A4 page budgeting (210mm x 297mm) without clipped content or orphan headers.
PERFORMANCE BUDGET: Vite build must compile in under 3.0s with zero TypeScript compilation errors.
acceptanceCriteria: Each of the 51 canonical templates (Cv1 to Cv51) faithfully renders its distinct visual structure, column distribution, meters, and typography matching its catalog thumbnail card.

Cv34 and all 2-column/banner templates display an edge-to-edge top header banner, left sidebar with skill rating meters & languages, and right main column with summary, employment, education, and credentials.
Real candidate data flows across all surfaces (/export/CvX/:id/en, PreviewModal in /dashboard/resumes, and /build-resume) with zero fallback to Alex Morgan mock data when authentic data exists.
All rich text (summary, experience descriptions, project descriptions) is sanitized via DOMPurify and rendered cleanly with zero raw HTML tags printed (

Frontend preview modal and export views display centered A4 sheets with smooth zoom controls and working Print, Share, and DOCX actions.

Playwright real-browser validation captures DOM proof and screenshots of Cv34 and other templates confirming visual parity and real data flow.
